name: design-skills
description: Ten skills for enterprise product design work. Work out what the problem actually is, sketch it as a breadboard, try two or three solution directions and pick one with a binary fit check inside a fixed time budget, wireframe the screens when layout turns out to be the real question, diagram what people are stuck on, then write it up as a proposal someone can approve or decline. Renderers turn the result into a scrollytelling explainer or a local tldraw canvas. Utilities capture how you write — from samples, a short exercise, or a voice note — and strip the AI tells out of anything drafted for a reader.
